verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing explicitly claims automated GL coding by entity globally with one-click accrual booking to close books daily, directly matching the story (brex-docs-8, brex-docs-14), backed by an Accounting API for managing accounting data across entities (brex-docs-1) and AI-powered automation messaging (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-9). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of GL-coding accuracy across entities and no third-party case study confirming close-acceleration outcomes.
